item.title: POTA Activation 8/8/26 at Morrow Mountain State Park – Photos
item.description:
On Saturday morning, August 8, 2026, Mark, William, Logan, Michael, Vik, Jim, Rick, Bob, Bryan, (Dick H. visited), and Darrell (Johnny couldn’t be with us) all enjoyed a great POTA activation at the scenic overlook of Morrow Mountain State Park. The views from Morrow Mountain were splendid!

After we had a great lunch at Five Points Public House (Instagram) in Albemarle where waitress Becky and her colleagues served us some delicious food.
